season_awards_and_stats#aw7.detail: Verified KXNHLADAMS is filed under season_awards_and_stats (series_assignment) and that no stage mapped the coach delta to a winner. Added stage s4 'Jack Adams coach-level choice model' (softmax over ~32 coaches with >=41 games, simulated final delta from team_season_points_distribution, 1/N ties per rules). Patched nhl.coach_expectation_delta measurement (all-coach conditional logit plus rank-ordered logit on NHLBA top-3; P_exp is computed in-house, so no archived projections are needed; MoneyPuck kept only as an optional cross-check) and added a coach branch to nhl.award_vote_share_model. Corrected s3: the electorate is the NHL Broadcasters' Association, 5-3-1 ballot, ballots unpublished (checked on NHL.com, 2026 Cooper 226 v Ruff 223). aw7 now covers only the projection-archive question.

season_futures#sf6.detail: Verified KXNHLRECORDWORST is filed under season_futures and its rules (league tiebreakers, then 1/N dead heat). Wired nhl.standings_stakes and nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing into season_futures stage s5 and situational_schedule_motivation coverage. Patched nhl.standings_stakes measurement with an exact post-deadline tanking regression (residual vs rating frozen at the deadline, on elimination, bottom-5 rank, value traded away and marginal lottery value per loss, shrunk to 0 with sd 0.05 pts/game). Lottery format checked online: 2 draws since 2021, 10-spot move-up cap, worst team 18.5%. sf6 now covers only the effect size.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.detail: Confirmed nhl.goalie_start_forecast defined only regular-season rotation rules. Patched its measurement with a playoff branch: a logistic starter-change hazard before game g+1 on the game-g save pct gap, whether the goalie was pulled, goals allowed, backup-minus-incumbent GSAx/60, elimination and injury flags, fitted on 2005-06+ playoff goalie logs (NHL API game type 3, Hockey-Reference). Referenced in the s1 description of unreg:playoff_series_aggregate, where it was already an input, and added to season_futures s4 input_ids (KXNHLSERIES/EAST/WEST/NHL). p5 now covers only the coefficient estimates.
